content:
{'text': '[Meta 旗下嘅 Muse AI 代理應用程式過去幾星期一直穩坐美國 App Store 免費 iPhone 應用榜首。今次最新嘅 Muse 應用程式更新新增咗一個新平台支援：iPad。]', 'translation': "[Meta's Muse AI agent app has been sitting at the top of the U.S. App Store's free iPhone app chart for the past few weeks. This latest Muse app update adds support for a new platform: iPad.]"}

{'text': '[Muse 係 Meta 推出嘅一個大部分免費、主動式嘅代理 AI 工具，競爭對手包括 Grok Bot、ChatGPT Dots 以及 OpenClaw。]', 'translation': '[Muse is a mostly free, proactive agent AI tool launched by Meta, with competitors including Grok Bot, ChatGPT Dots, and OpenClaw.]'}

{'text': '[今次最新嘅應用程式更新將支援平台由 iPhone 擴展到 iPad，同時加入咗更多連接器等功能。以下係今次更新嘅版本說明：]', 'translation': '[This latest app update expands platform support from iPhone to iPad, while adding more connectors and other features. Below are the release notes for this update:]'}

  • {'text': '[協助你發展業務：連接你已經用緊嘅工具，例如 Asana、Canva、Dropbox、Figma、QuickBooks、GitHub、Klaviyo、Zoom 以及 Meta 廣告帳戶]', 'translation': '[Help you grow your business: Connect tools you already use, such as Asana, Canva, Dropbox, Figma, QuickBooks, GitHub, Klaviyo, Zoom, and Meta Ads accounts]'}
  • {'text': '[搵新客：畀 Muse 一個業務目標，佢就會幫你完成，由籌劃市場推廣內容、建立客戶推銷方案，以至快速搭建新嘅產品頁面，全程都會經過你嘅批准]', 'translation': '[Find new customers: Give Muse a business goal, and it will help you accomplish it—from planning marketing content, building customer outreach campaigns, to quickly building new product pages, with your approval throughout]'}
  • {'text': '[更多連接器：連結你日常用嚟處理工作嘅應用程式，例如 Granola、Notion 等等]', 'translation': '[More connectors: Link apps you use daily to get work done, such as Granola, Notion, and more]'}
  • {'text': '[Muse 而家已經喺 iPad 上提供]', 'translation': '[Muse is now available on iPad]'}

{'text': '[以下係一啲嚟自 App Store 嘅 Muse iPad 版螢幕截圖：]', 'translation': '[Below are some screenshots of Muse for iPad from the App Store:]'}

{'text': '[Muse 最初喺今年九月為 iPhone 推出，幾日之後 Meta 再加入咗 Mac 版本。]', 'translation': '[Muse was initially launched for iPhone in September this year, and a few days after, Meta added a Mac version.]'}

{'text': '[Muse iPhone 及 iPad 版本而家可以喺 App Store 免費下載。]', 'translation': '[Muse for iPhone and iPad is now available for free download on the App Store.]'}

{'text': '[盡情發揮你 Apple 產品嘅威力]', 'translation': '[Get the most out of your Apple devices]'}
